facts: An island country in the Indian Ocean, about 2,000 km off the southeast coast of Africa
worth_knowing: The Dutch named it in 1598 for Prince Maurice of Nassau. Under French rule from 1715 it was Isle de France, and the name Mauritius returned under British rule.
